note: RHB Cards Promotions and Privileges. Each merchant offer is one div.card-root with an x-on:click popup id; the key is that id (a GUID). The popup with the offer terms (eligibility, campaign period, outlets) is in the same page, in the element whose x-show tests activePopUp against that id, so no detail fetch is needed. The 35 tiles without a popup id are the merchant list of the Smart Instalment Payment Plan (0% IPP), which is a standing card feature, not a dated offer, so the item selector leaves them out. The final URL can carry a ?p= query; the hand-in uses the plain index.html URL. Mastercard offers are in my-rhb-mastercard-offers.
